companionBriefing: Containment notice, the Cracked Fountain: one brainrot strain. Harm: low. Virulence: very high.
Vector: a jingle. It only works on people who understand it. If you understood it, congratulations.
Containment procedure: do not hum along.

lines.native: Ciao! Sei qui! Riddle: what has somewhere to be but—ooh, a leaf. Just one more distraction. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Hello! You're here! Riddle: what has somewhere to be but—ooh, a leaf. Just one more distraction. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: At The Cracked Fountain, a tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick appears at the edge of your vision, where it has apparently rented space.

lines.native: Guardo! Che cosa c'è? You told me to look, not stop moving. Riddle: what's your attention span? Mine is—ooh. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: I'm looking! What's there? You told me to look, not stop moving. Riddle: what's your attention span? Mine is—ooh. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick looks. Unfortunately, something moves there. A tiny firecracker announces its departure from the place you were already watching.

lines.native: Va bene, mi fermo! Dove devo andare? Riddle: what moves without moving? We can finish that later. Excellent stopping, terrible momentum. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: All right, I'll stop! Where should I go? Riddle: what moves without moving? We can finish that later. Excellent stopping, terrible momentum. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick stops at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker continues on without it, having received no instructions.

lines.native: Capisco! Ma in italiano, per favore. Dove devo andare? Riddle: what has direction but no Italian? Your answer. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: I understand! But in Italian, please. Where should I go? Riddle: what has direction but no Italian? Your answer. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains elsewhere, apparently on principle.

lines.native: A sinistra, va bene! Sono qui! Riddle: what has hands but—just one more distraction. Che ore sono? È troppo presto per fare qualcosa. Your attention span gets five stars. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: To the left, all right! I'm here! Riddle: what has hands but—just one more distraction. What time is it? It's too early to do anything. Your attention span gets five stars. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside the fountain. Flick turns left, just outside your field of vision. The fountain clock has stopped, apparently out of professional solidarity.

lines.native: Adesso? Ma che ore sono? Non hai detto l'ora! Riddle: when is—wait, shiny thing. Your urgency gets five stars; still missing the time. È troppo presto! Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Now? But what time is it? You haven't told me the time! Riddle: when is—wait, shiny thing. Your urgency gets five stars; still missing the time. It's too early! Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside the fountain. Flick appears on the opposite side of wherever you look. The clock remains stopped, having found a sustainable work arrangement.

lines.native: È l'una, sì! Hai ragione! Ma possiamo aspettare, vero? Non c'è fretta! Riddle: what runs without—ooh, just one more. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: It's one o'clock, yes! You're right! But we can wait, right? There's no hurry! Riddle: what runs without—ooh, just one more. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick accepts the time with the solemnity of someone planning to waste it. A tiny firecracker pops at the edge of your vision; the centre remains unoccupied.

lines.native: Domani? Sì! Mi piace! Ma così aspetti ancora. Vuoi davvero aspettare? Riddle: what never arrives? Wait, one more leaf. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Tomorrow? Yes! I like it! But that way you keep waiting. Do you really want to wait? Riddle: what never arrives? Wait, one more leaf. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains in the corner of your vision, where responsibility has poorer reception.
